notes.title: Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you all so much for the kind words and support! It's crazy to us that so many people have played and enjoyed our game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34426734/874dea54ae5d41b61d589df38c37e24681abdbad.gif

We may have playtested the game a bunch, but there's always going to be new issues - please let us know if you find something or have an issue somewhere! Most of the time, the issues can be temporarily solved by going back to the main menu and resetting the scene, but please let us know anyway so we can make sure it doesn't happen to anyone else!

We're currently working on patching an issue with the final scene, along with some small fixes that don't affect the gameplay as much - thanks to our players who told us about these issues! You da real team clam.

Finally, if you played the game and enjoyed it, consider leaving a review!

That's all from us, talk to you guys later!

Much love,
Team Clam

notes.title: The release is coming up! Achievements are in!
notes.notes:
Quick update everyone - the game build is just about done! The last thing on our list was the achievements, which are now in the game! We're incredibly excited about Clam Man and we hope you are too.

We've also updated our Steam page with some new graphics! It looks way better now! Right? Doesnt it? Eh? Just a little?

Just a few more days, and our debut title is up! That's crazy!

Anyway, back to testing. 
Much love,
Team Clam <3

notes.title: QUICK UPDATE - WE'RE GETTING THERE - MUSIC IS PRETTY COOL
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34426734/5e9968e6ffbb361ba6ff71130dfc99ce1b0de8c4.png
Here's a quick update because we've been super quiet lately:


  The game is coming along real nicely! Right now, we're fixing bugs, adding sound effects and polishing dialogue. We're well on time though.
  Our composer has finished about 60% of the soundtrack so far, and we're super excited about how it's turning out. We can't wait for you guys to hear it.
 To all our Indiegogo backers: Most of your rewards, such as items and portraits, are in the game already!


That's all from me for now. Gonna go back to doing important dev stuff.

See you guys later!

Clam Man & Team Clam
